𝗙𝗜𝗥𝗦𝗧 𝗠𝗔𝗟𝗘 𝗕𝗔𝗧𝗧𝗘𝗥 𝗧𝗢 𝟮𝟬𝟬 𝗜𝗡 𝗢𝗗𝗜𝘀 🔥

Sachin Tendulkar, 200* off 147 balls vs South Africa, Gwalior, 24 Feb 2010.
India finished on 401/3 and won by 153 runs. 🏏

#Cricket #Tendulkar
